package.name: morai_v2_1_ros2_msgs
package.description: Hand-authored subset of MORAI SIM's morai_v2_1_ros2_msgs package, containing only the messages this stack actually consumes (VehicleManualControl, VehicleInfo). MORAI does not publish the original message source for this product line (only compiled Windows rosidl typesupport DLLs ship with the simulator), so each field layout here was reconstructed from the Message Template table shown in MORAI's Interface editor: - VehicleManualControl: throttle, brake, steering_wheel_angle, all float64/double, in that order. - VehicleInfo (generated from MORAI's own VehicleInfo.tmpl, bound to a GroundTruth entity): stamp (int32 sec + uint32 nanosec), string id, then float32 triples for location/rotation/local_velocity/ local_acceleration/angular_velocity, then float32 throttle/brake/steer_angle — 21 fields total, in that order. Used for real vehicle speed (local_velocity), since the IMU-only ROS2_Odometry path never populated linear velocity (see DEBUG.md). If MORAI ever publishes the real package, replace this one with it.
